name: Founder decision: Mark each principle in version one as a feedback reference, a commitment, or an operating rule, and re-mark two of Session 2's candidates
markdown_description:
P34 and P35. Feedback references the range card, the seat sheet, the readiness rows and load read, the non-negotiables as the flag's, canon's service model as behavior, and the charter's principles once version one exists, and nothing referenced in coaching is a fifth scorecard dimension. A principle is a feedback reference only if it names a behavior a service produces, observable from the room's owner's coverage position or on a record the person can read, in one service, without inferring a state of the person. Run on Session 2's seven candidates, five pass (authority lives in the domain; what allowed this, not who failed; management absorbs blame, for a lead only; no hierarchy of importance; never assert the unproven) and two fail as feedback references and go back to the charter to be marked as a commitment and an operating rule rather than dropped (pay for what matters; advancement requires preparation, not permission). The test runs at ratification and at every revision; canon's positioning words are never a feedback reference about a person. Extends `86akh3tg0`, `86akh674t`, and `86akh3trj` by reference and closes `86akh3wxv`'s S12 half. Blocks row 154. Normal.

Filed by Session 12 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmjba`. Reasoning lives on the S12 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
